NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager drinks cool water straight from a freshly opened coconut.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) drinks cool water straight from a freshly opened coconut. Some of it runs down (name1)'s chin, and nobody minds.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) drinks cool water straight from a freshly opened coconut. (name1) scrapes out the soft flesh and shares it with a friend.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) drinks cool water straight from a freshly opened coconut. A curious goat watches hopefully until (name1) gives it the empty shell.

e1__fx.name: Ending 1
e1__fx.text: (name1) drinks cool water straight from a freshly opened coconut. It is exactly what (name1) needed on such a hot day.
